content:
The Black Friday deals are here, but you don't have to spend a fortune to pick up some new kit. There are little additions you can make that don't cost a fortune that can make a real difference to your setup.

While you're out searching for a great discount on a new GPU or SSD, you might miss out on those little impulsive purchases, the gadgets and trinkets that aren't going to be life-changing, but will add real value. To help you, we've put together a list of 13 of the best budget-friendly gadgets, tools, and accessories that you can pick up for less than $13 right now.

These deals aren't going to break the bank, but that's the point: they're not supposed to. These are just little add-ons, but they'll also make for great gifts for any techies in your family or amongst your friends. We've got gadgets that can help improve your network connectivity at home, not to mention add USB ports, improve the stability of your graphics cards, give your headphones somewhere to hang, and plenty more. Take a look through our list and see what takes your fancy.

Quick Links: 13 under $13

Cables and adapters

You'll always need a cable you don't have when you least expect it. Don't be caught short: you can pick up cables, cheaply, to help you power the peripherals and accessories you need. These cable selections below will help you restock your cable drawer with some of the must-own essentials.

100W Nexode USB-C to USB-C Retractable Cable 3.3FT: was $16.99 now $12.82
A full 1-meter (3.3FT) USB Type-C to USB Type-C cable that supports up to 100W is always useful, but this retractable cable from UGreen keeps things neat and tidy. Throw it in your bag and don't worry about untangling a mess of wires while commuting: it's just ready when you need it. View Deal

USB-C to USB-C 60w Fast Charging Cable (2-Pack): was $9.99 now $7.99
Charge your headphones, mobile phone, or any other USB-C devices with this great value 2-pack of Anker charging cables. View Deal

2 x USB C to USB C Coiled Data Cable: was $16.56 now $12.92
A two-pack of USB Type-C to Type-C cables. Exciting! These are perfect for a car, especially as they're coiled, which reduces their size to 1.3ft, while still giving you a max length of 3.3ft. These support fast PD 3.0 charging, so you can get your smartphones and tablets charged in fast order. They're braided, too, for extra durability.

Click the coupon for a 22% discount. View Deal

Tools

Every PC builder and maker needs a decent toolkit. If you want to keep your PC running properly, you'll want to invest in some key tools that you can pull out when you need to. You could spend a fortune here, but these tools for $13 or less will make for useful additions to your set.

Keyboard Cleaning Kit with Brush: was $14.99 now $10.57
This keyboard cleaning kit features a whole host of tiny tools to help you clear away dirt, grime, and anything else you can think of. All of the tools are housed in a neat multi-tool arrangement, and you get tools to remove dirt and detritus from every aspect of your digital devices. Key cap puller, brushes, lens cleaning, a spray bottle of isopropyl alcohol, metal pins to remove earwax from headphones, and a sponge to keep grease marks off your screen. View Deal

Silicone Air Blower With Long Nozzle: was $10.6 now $8.48
A cheap and sustainable alternative to compressed air can, this silicone air blower will let you pump air to clear dust and grime from your PC case, keyboard and other electronics. View Deal

PC Accessories

There are accessories and consumables for your PC that you probably won't think about. There's your CPU: why not add some new thermal paste to keep it cool? You could add an SD card reader to make it easier to grab photos from your camera. Not to mention a gigabit network switch to improve connectivity around the home. All these, for less than $13 each.

TF9 2.9g Thermal Paste: was $6.89 now $5.51
Coming third in our best thermal paste guide, this is an excellent thermal paste from Thermalright.

In our review, we noted that it has excellent thermal performance, delivering great stability as a result. This paste is easy to use and clean up when reapplication is required. View Deal

Graphics Card GPU Brace Support: was $8.54 now $7.25
No gimmicks, no fuss, this GPU support brace will stop your (most likely very expensive) GPU from sagging and breaking in your (again, very expensive) gaming rig. If you're spending hundreds or thousands, don't cheap out on the support to keep it safe! View Deal

This SD card reader is from budget-friendly Ugreen and has been previously recommended by Tom's Hardware staffers in the past. With it, you can read microSD, SD, Compact Flash, and Sony Memory Stick cards. Whenever there is a panicked "I've lost the adapter for my camera's memory card" during the holidays, you'll have what you need to save the day with this reader in your pocket. View Deal

5-Port Ethernet Switch: was $9.99 now $7.99
A five-port Ethernet switch for less than $10 is a typo, right? Nope. It's not fancy, it's unmanaged, no PoE, and it "only" has Gigabit ports, but when you need a few extra Ethernet ports, this sub $10 switch is a great deal to keep working. View Deal

The TP-Link Litewave 5-Port Gigabit Ethernet Switch LS1005G provides four additional Ethernet ports, delivering reliable, high-speed wired internet for your gaming PC, NAS, console, TV, and other connected devices. Another popular Tom's Hardware recommendation and one that several of us own ourselves. View Deal

AX900 USB Wi-Fi 6 Adapter: was $12.99 now $9.49
You've got an old PC, and it doesn't have Wi-Fi. You don't want to spend a ton of money to give it Wi-Fi. This under-$13 Wi-Fi 6 USB dongle will give you the Wi-Fi connection you need at decently fast speeds.

It works without a driver for Windows 10 and 11, and it will most likely work with Linux, but you'll need to take an extra step. View Deal

Desk Accessories

You can pick up these desk accessories to help give your PC setup a boost, from extra USB ports to a headphone bracket to clear space on your desk. There's even an external power button, meaning you don't have to keep reaching underneath your desk to switch your machine on (or off).

External Power Button for Desktop PC: was $13.99 now $11.19
This slick external power button features a 2-meter (78.74 inch) cable and a splitter that lets you connect both to your case's front panel buttons. It also includes adhesive pads and zip-ties. View Deal

Dual Controller & Headphone Holder Stand: was $12.95 now $10.36
Keep your desk tidy with this simple wall mounted hanger for your headphones, along with support for up to two Xbox, PlayStation, Switch or PC gamepads, too. View Deal

Rotating Headphone Stand: was $11.99 now $8.79
This headphone stand clips onto your desk so your headphones can hang off the side rather than taking up valuable table real estate. View Deal

USB 3.0 Hub, 4 port: was $9.99 now $6.62
Too many USB cables to deal with on your desk? This UGREEN USB 3.0 splitter hooks up to a USB-A port and provides you with four additional ports to connect other devices, from keyboards and mice to webcams and flash drives. View Deal
